folds: leave-one-nominal-frequency-level-out (5 folds), labels from targets_design freq_Hz

freq_inputs.measured_agree: tap_rate_used_Hz where |spectral_rate_Hz - tap| / tap <= 0.1, else nominal

salama_shape.note: shape fitted in log space with one free amplitude per film; the sweep spans 1 to 5 Hz, so on our 5 to 25 Hz grid the shape is used outside the range it was fitted on

models.lorspec: ProductGP with Lorentzian-spectrum kernel in f (a10_methods.predict_lorspec)
models.tr_lor_mean: Salama Lorentzian shape, amplitude (a0 + a1 c + a2 c^2) F refitted per fold, no GP
models.tr_lor_gp: tr_lor_mean + plain GP on the residual
models.tr_pow_mean: Salama power-law shape f^b, amplitude refitted per fold, no GP
models.tr_pow_gp: tr_pow_mean + plain GP on the residual
models.oracle_shape_gp: LEAKY DIAGNOSTIC: twin/law shape (f0, gamma fitted on all rows incl. the held-out level), amplitude per fold + GP
models.mf_ar1: twin low fidelity (in-fold law, in-fold kappa, h(c)) x rho + plain GP (AR(1) multi-fidelity)
models.mf_nar: GP on (x, twin low fidelity) (nonlinear autoregressive multi-fidelity)

twin_import: a6_twin.response and a6_twin.h_factor imported (main block not run); the twin's full-grid law and kappa are not used because they were fitted on all 75 recordings

round2.description: A folds on measured-rate bands (edges 7.5/12.5/17.5/22.5 Hz; quantile sensitivity), B clean subset (tap rate within 10 percent of the label, copies dropped), C per-cycle continuum (instantaneous rate from inter-peak intervals, leave-one-rate-band-out, training drops every recording with a test cycle), D peak-shape prior (law mean with training-fold f0, gamma; hierarchical law with f0, gamma pooled across compositions, kappa by inner leave-one-group-out folds of the training rows)

meta.peak_rule: argmax |v - median| inside each a1 cycle window; interval kept if within 0.5 to 1.5 periods; cycle rate = 1 kHz / mean of its valid adjacent intervals

verdict.invalid_label_leak: rate-band folds with the nominal label as input are not a held-out-frequency test: in every rate band all test recordings carry a label value that also occurs in the training rows (per_level n_test_label_seen_in_train), so they are excluded from every list below

round2.verdict_text: Under measured-rate folds (measured rate as input) the held-out-frequency collapse becomes zero skill (pooled R2 about 0), not recovered skill; the interior 10 and 15 Hz levels interpolate only under label folds; the 20 Hz peak and the 5 and 25 Hz edges are predicted by no method (measured rate, rate-band folds, clean subset, per-cycle continuum, transfer and twin priors, hierarchical peak prior).

tables.tab_a11_levels.tex: within-level R2 of held-out frequency per level and band mean (n75); dagger = leaky oracle
tables.tab_a11_bands.tex: band-pooled R2 of held-out frequency by frequency input (n75)
tables.tab_a11_levels_n72.tex: within-level R2 of held-out frequency per level and band mean (n72); dagger = leaky oracle
tables.tab_a11_bands_n72.tex: band-pooled R2 of held-out frequency by frequency input (n72)
tables.tab_a11_rates.tex: recordings with tap rate >10% off nominal or tap and spectral rates disagreeing
tables.tab_a11_r2_folds.tex: round 2 A/B (n75): R2 per held-out group (columns 1-5 = 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 Hz labels or rate bands; quantile rows: lowest to highest rate quintile), pooled, interior and edge band-pooled R2; double dagger = label input under rate-band folds, label values of the test band occur in training, not a held-out-frequency test
tables.tab_a11_r2_folds_n72.tex: round 2 A/B (n72): R2 per held-out group (columns 1-5 = 5, 10, 15, 20, 25 Hz labels or rate bands; quantile rows: lowest to highest rate quintile), pooled, interior and edge band-pooled R2; double dagger = label input under rate-band folds, label values of the test band occur in training, not a held-out-frequency test
tables.tab_a11_r2_peak.tex: round 2 D: held-out 20 Hz (label fold or rate band), n75 / clean; f0 = training-fold law peak (median over compositions for the hierarchical law)
tables.tab_a11_r2_cycles.tex: round 2 C: per-cycle R2 per held-out band, pooled per cycle and per recording (mean of test cycles)

index.macros: numbers_a11.tex (prefix frq; Excl = n72; Nom/Meas/Agree = frequency input)
